selected.title: What the eye misses
selected.texas_link: Si-Ware announced its new United States headquarters in Austin on September 17th.

movement.object: Austin headquarters and planned physical AI application lab

selected.why_today: The company announced its Austin opening this week and invites partners to investigate concrete material sensing applications.
selected.consequence: Robotics teams have a proposed local route to test whether contact sensing can inform material handling decisions.
selected.application_change: Material composition could inform an automated handling decision beyond the appearance recorded by a camera.
selected.counter_image: The application lab is planned, and an unfamiliar sample needs a relevant learned reference before recognition. No deployed sorting result is reported.
selected.earned_take: A useful next move depends on what the machine can verify about the thing it touches.

agency.next_step: Interested organizations can discuss feasibility and requirements with the Austin team; no public trial recruitment or deployment result is announced.
agency.who_can_act: Robotics developers, researchers and prospective technology partners can contact the company.
